text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD alert: HIGH - gpu-node-42 (rack-7) heartbeat lost, kubelet NotReady + kernel panic suspected. Incident ID: PD-89321. Auto-page to eng-oncall (primary). :rotating_light:

maria: acked. I'm on it, grabbing serial console.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by maria (oncall). Escalation pause 2m.

maria: quick check — `kubectl get nodes` shows: `gpu-node-42   NotReady`.

leo: any customer impact? I see a few pods pinned to that node (dedicated-pool-3).

maria: running `kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-node-42` now.

maria: pods list — 2 x model-inference (tenant: cleap), 1 x exporter, 1 x logging-sidecar.

ajay: tagging infra-hw for serial/RMA: @chip-team FYI.

maria: attaching serial logs:
```
[7376.123] kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 00000000
[7376.124] kernel: CPU: 0 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/0 Not tainted 5.15.0-rc
[7376.125] kernel: print_req_error: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 0
```

maria: can't ssh, serial hung, console shows kernel oops.

leo: can we cordon + drain to reduce customer impact?

maria: yes. running:
`kubectl cordon gpu-node-42 && kubectl drain gpu-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`

incident-bot: Drain job started by maria. Pods being evicted (3/3).

maria: evictions complete. No restart failures reported. cleap reported ~3 failed requests during the window — ops-notify pinged for customer follow-up.

ajay: picked up. I'm prepping IPMI powercycle and will attempt a soft-reset. ETA ~3m.

maria: noted. @ops-notify pinged customers and documented impact in the incident doc.

ajay: soft reset failed (no response). will escalate to chip-team for RMA. opening ticket: HW-4422.

dina: (chip-team) acknowledged. scheduling RMA, provisioning replacement node in same rack, pre-pulling images.

maria: handing off to ajay for hardware follow-through. I'll quiet oncall notifications for this thread.

ajay: action items: RMA created, replacement targeted to be online in ~4h, traffic routed away from node. I'll update timeline as hw updates come in. :thumbsup: 

maria: followup - please include kernel oops snippet + list of affected tenants in postmortem.

incident-bot: thread closed by maria (oncall). Follow-up required: postmortem, customer notify. Final status: node cordoned, pods evacuated, replacement scheduled.
